Class TextRendering3D

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.panel.TextRendering3D
public final class TextRendering3D extends Object
Utility for rendering crisp, screen-space text associated with 3D world positions in an MDI-3D Panel3D.

The class projects a world-space point into window coordinates and then uses JOGL's TextRenderer to draw the text in pixel coordinates. This gives the text a constant on-screen size regardless of zoom, which is usually what is wanted for axes, tick labels, point labels, and plot annotations.

Important implementation detail: TextRenderer.beginRendering(...) installs a 2D projection. Therefore this helper snapshots the 3D scene matrices before the first text draw in each pass and uses those saved matrices for all later world-to-screen projections in that pass.

    • drawWorld

      public boolean drawWorld(Panel3D panel3D, com.jogamp.opengl.GL2 gl, String text, float x, float y, float z, int dx, int dy, TextRendering3D.Anchor anchor, TextRendering3D.Style style)
      Draw text attached to a 3D world coordinate.
      Parameters:
      panel3D - owning panel, retained for call-site clarity
      gl - current GL2 context while the 3D model-view/projection state is active
      text - text to draw; blank or null text is ignored
      x - world x coordinate
      y - world y coordinate
      z - world z coordinate
      dx - pixel offset applied after projection, positive right
      dy - pixel offset applied after projection, positive up
      anchor - text anchor; if null, TextRendering3D.Anchor.LEFT is used
      style - drawing style; if null, TextRendering3D.Style.label() is used
      Returns:
      true if the label was drawn; false if skipped
